title: Perfect closed immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. It is a *perfect closed immersion* if Y has an affine open covering by U=\operatorname{Spec}A [def-weil-affine-spectrum] such that i^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) and the A-module A/I admits a bounded resolution by finite projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] A-modules (equivalently, after refining this affine covering, by finite free A-modules).
